description: This Java class, CHeaderConsumer, implements the ConfigurationConsumer interface to generate a C header file with specific format, including header guards and boilerplate comments. It writes structured content to a BufferedWriter and references external classes ConfigDefinition and ConfigStructure.

classes.name: CHeaderConsumer
classes.description: A consumer class that writes C header code based on configuration structures.

methods.name: CHeaderConsumer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BufferedWriter used for output.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Initializes the C header file with comments, header guards, and includes.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Closes header guards and adds ending comments.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a configuration structure by writing its header representation.
